Average length and k1 are positive finite values <= 2**53; b is in [0,1].
Empty queries and zero-length documents score zero. Unseen terms may have

populations. No tokenization, text normalization, fitting, labels, query
weighting or task-specific policy. Positive IDF, exact lengths and (k1+1)
scale are explicit; no bitwise Lucene-equivalence claim.

Aligned count lists for distinct unit-weight query terms; Python integer counts in [0,2**53], positive corpus size, document frequencies at most corpus size, and total supplied term frequency at most document length. Positive finite average length and k1 at most 2**53; b in [0,1]. Uses positive log1p IDF and the explicit (k1+1) saturation scale. Zero frequencies contribute zero; empty query and empty document score zero when arithmetic controls are representable. Rejects nonfinite intermediate/output arithmetic. No text, token alignment, corpus fitting, labels or split policy is inferred.

Average length and k1 are positive finite values <= 2**53; b is in [0,1].
Empty queries and zero-length documents score zero. Unseen terms may have
df zero. Rejects nonfinite intermediates/results; inputs are unchanged.

row.constraints:

Uses log1p((N-df+.5)/(df+.5)) IDF and tf*(k1+1)/(tf+k1*(1-b+b*dl/avgdl)).

corpus size is positive, df <= N, and sum(tf) <= document length.
Average length and k1 are positive finite values <= 2**53; b is in [0,1].
Empty queries and zero-length documents score zero. Unseen terms may have
df zero. Rejects nonfinite intermediates/results; inputs are unchanged.

Caller supplies distinct-term alignment, corpus statistics and fitting
populations. No tokenization, text normalization, fitting, labels, query
weighting or task-specific policy. Positive IDF, exact lengths and (k1+1)
scale are explicit; no bitwise Lucene-equivalence claim.
